sections.name: A. Global shell and spatial continuity

items.description: Active global destination is distinguishable without color alone.
Global destination hit targets remain usable at compact widths.
Route title never competes visually with the primary work objective.
Project/context identity remains visible when route changes.
Running mission state survives navigation without becoming a decorative badge.
Runtime/provider truth summary never implies provider availability from configuration alone.
Experience switcher communicates current regime and preserves user context.
Switching experience level does not reset scroll, project, mission or dirty state unexpectedly.
Command/search invocation returns focus to a deterministic target when dismissed.
Escape unwinds overlays in a deterministic inner-to-outer order.
Window drag regions never swallow interactive controls.
Shell resize never produces clipped rail labels or unreachable actions.
Shell chrome is quieter than active work surfaces in both light and nocturne themes.
Titlebar treatment is correct per Windows/macOS/Linux shell mode.
App-level critical update/error state is visible but does not permanently dominate navigation.
Global notification indicators expose count/status accessibly.
Keyboard navigation does not trap focus in rail/context dock.
Restored shell layout rejects impossible/outdated geometry safely.
Shell at 125%, 150%, 175%, 200% zoom/reflow preserves primary actions.
Fractional DPI does not create one-pixel seams between rail, dock and work canvas.
Heading scale is mapped to information priority rather than route type alone.
Small uppercase labels have adequate tracking and contrast.
Mono is restricted to machine identifiers, code, paths, hashes, receipts and commands.
Numeric telemetry uses tabular numerals where comparison/scan benefits.
Vietnamese diacritics do not clip at line box boundaries.
Mixed Vietnamese + English + code text maintains readable baseline/rhythm.
Long provider/model names do not break layout or hide state.
Long Windows paths and POSIX paths wrap/copy predictably.
Hashes/IDs have intentional truncation with accessible/full-value retrieval.
Ellipsis means content truncation, never uncertain state.
Empty-state text does not exceed comfortable reading width.
Error copy preserves actionable detail without raw stack noise in Everyday mode.
Expert mode may expose raw detail without making it the primary label.
Font fallback does not shift controls enough to break alignment.
Text remains readable during font loading/fallback.
Disabled text is still readable when meaning is required.
Selected text contrast works in light/nocturne/forced-colors.
Code/terminal text sizes remain readable at compact density.
Truncated labels expose full value via a non-hover-only path.
Copy terminology is consistent across Home, Mission, Review, Settings and Control Plane.

Consequence plates visually dominate routine separators but not mission objective.
Evidence trace markers align to the text/event baseline they describe.
Empty placeholder glyphs do not look like disabled interactive controls.
Divider/rule colors remain perceptible in nocturne without creating a grid cage.
Layout remains stable when optional metadata appears/disappears.
Optical review at reduced scale does not reveal random density islands.

sections.name: I. Agent execution and evidence semantics

Queued work is distinct from running work.
Parallel tasks expose relationship/ownership without overwhelming Everyday mode.
Tool invocation identifies tool boundary.
Permission request identifies requested capability and scope.
Waiting on user differs from waiting on provider/tool.

Unknown state is not rendered as neutral success.
